dentalImplants.title: Dental Implants
dentalImplants.description: Dental implants are a long-lasting solution for replacing missing teeth with artificial ones that look and function like natural teeth.

cosmeticCare.title: Cosmetic Dental Care Whitening
cosmeticCare.description: Cosmetic dental care involves treatments like teeth whitening, bonding, and veneers to improve the appearance of your smile.

veneer.title: Veneer
veneer.description: Veneers are thin layers of porcelain or composite material that are applied to the front of the teeth to improve their appearance.

dentures.title: Dentures
dentures.description: Dentures are removable replacements for missing teeth, designed to restore both function and aesthetics to your smile.

surgicalProcedures.title: Surgical Procedures
surgicalProcedures.description: Surgical procedures in dentistry include tooth extractions, gum surgery, and other interventions to treat various dental conditions.

pediatricDentistry.title: Pediatric Dentistry
pediatricDentistry.description: Pediatric dentistry focuses on the dental care of children, ensuring they maintain healthy teeth and gums as they grow.

endodontics.title: Endodontics
endodontics.description: Endodontics involves treatments related to the inside of the tooth, including root canals and other procedures to save damaged or infected teeth.

orthopedics.title: Orthopedics
orthopedics.description: Orthopedics in dentistry focuses on the diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of misaligned teeth and jaw problems, including TMJ disorders.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.description: Orthodontics focuses on the correction of irregularities in teeth and jaws using braces, aligners, and other corrective devices.

about.paragraph: Welcome to one of the most reputable and successful dental clinics in Yerevan. Our dedicated team, led by Dr. Manuk Melkonyan and Dr. Gayane Barseghyan, is committed to providing top-quality dental care in a comfortable and professional environment.

manuk.name: Manuk Melkonyan
manuk.description: Manuk Melkonyan graduated from the Faculty of Dentistry at Yerevan State Medical University named after M. Heratsi (2004–2009), then continued his studies in the university’s residency program, specializing in family dentistry (2009–2011). From 2011 to 2013, he served in the Armenian Army as a dental surgeon, combining his professional duties with military responsibility. Throughout his professional development, he has undergone training in Italy, France, and Spain, and participated in numerous international congresses and conferences. Dr. Melkonyan is a member of the Armenian Endodontists Association and has 14 years of professional experience, having helped tens of thousands of patients regain their healthy and confident smile.

gayane.name: Gayane Barseghyan
gayane.description: Gayane Barseghyan graduated from the Faculty of Dentistry at Yerevan State Medical University named after M. Heratsi (1980–1985), then completed an internship in general dentistry (1985–1986). In 1993, she received a qualification in pediatric dentistry, and in 1999–2000, she further specialized in the field of pediatric general dental practice. Throughout her long career, Dr. Barseghyan has completed professional training in France, Poland, and Georgia, and has participated in numerous international conferences and professional events. She is a member of the Armenian Endodontists Association and brings over 40 years of experience, having earned a reputation for trust and warmth among both children and adult patients. Tens of thousands of satisfied patients stand as the best testament to her professional dedication.

aghasi.name: Aghasi Gabrielyan
aghasi.description: Aghasi Gabrielyan studied at the Faculty of Dentistry of Yerevan State Medical University named after M. Heratsi from 2004 to 2009, and then continued his postgraduate education in orthodontics from 2009 to 2012. From 2012 to 2014, he served in the Armenian Army as a dental surgeon, combining his professional skills with military duties. Dr. Gabrielyan has regularly participated in professional conferences, deepening his knowledge in modern orthodontic methods and technologies. He has 13 years of professional experience and is known for his high standards and results-driven approach in clinical practice.
